user.title: Configure SmartRent
user.description: Enter your SmartRent credentials. If your account uses an authenticator app, paste its TOTP secret into 'Authenticator secret key' and Home Assistant will generate the codes itself — you will not be asked for one again, including after a restart. Leave the one-off '2fa Code' blank when you do that.
